create_toolbox: create a Toolbox instance with a list of Tool objects for agent operations
add_tool_to_toolbox: add a new Tool to an existing Toolbox using the add_tool method
remove_tool_from_toolbox: remove a tool by name from the Toolbox using the remove_tool method
show_tool_descriptions: show descriptions of all tools in the Toolbox using show_tool_descriptions with a Jinja template
get_tool_description_with_args: get a formatted description string for a single Tool using get_tool_description_with_args
